## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the problem and what changes for a user. Link a public issue if relevant; keep private discussions out of the description.

## Validation

List commands run, results with counts, skipped checks and failures. If a check was rerun, report both results. State what was not verified. Include synthetic before/after screenshots for visible changes.

- [ ] Typecheck, unit tests, licence check and E2E results are recorded.
- [ ] Examples, logs, screenshots and files contain no real collections, credentials or private data.
- [ ] Dependency changes retain permissive licences and complete notices; no native modules or telemetry were added.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behaviour and known limits.

For packaging changes, also report the target operating system, packaged self-tests and About check. Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.
